mnn-3.6.1-arm64.tar.gz contains the unmodified arm64-v8a libMNN.so and
libMNN_CL.so from the official Android release, the six public headers
required by Interpreter.hpp, and LICENSE.txt from the matching source tag.
The application supplies libc++_shared.so from its Android NDK.
